# VirtualTabs

> VirtualTabs is a VS Code extension for persistent virtual file groups,
> multi-root workspaces, and AI-agent integration.

Use the links below as the canonical sources for current rules, commands,
counts, paths, and procedures.

## Documentation

- [Full context](https://winterdrive.github.io/vscode-virtual-tabs/llms-full.txt): Generated aggregate of the canonical documentation listed below.
- [Product overview and usage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/main/README.md): Installation, features, user workflows, and project links.
- [Product philosophy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/main/docs/PHILOSOPHY.md): The product problem and design motivation.
- [MCP client setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/main/docs/mcp-setup.md): Current AI-client and Agent Skill setup.
- [MCP server reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/main/mcp-server/README.md): Architecture, primitives, capabilities, build, and startup.
- [Agent Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/main/skills/virtualtabs/SKILL.md): Canonical agent behavior and fallback safety workflow.
- [Development guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/main/DEVELOPMENT.md): Local development and extension architecture.
- [Testing guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/main/docs/TESTING.md): Current suites, commands, UI/E2E constraints, and limitations.
- [Contributing guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Repository language, contribution, and pull-request expectations.
- [Localization guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/main/I18N.md): Localization and documentation translation policy.
- [Release policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/main/docs/RELEASE_POLICY.md): Release channels, trains, gates, authorization, and contributor fast lane.

## Optional
